authorization: 进入“研究诊断及学习反馈”状态，开展定向诊断
question: Do causal local fixed-support recovery states distinguish future executable net returns, or merely relabel rolling-low movement?
scope: One bounded S014 diagnosis; existing pinned data only; zero new accounts, upstream calls, candidates, or parameter searches. No stage-four advancement. All data already seen.
population: All 1642 evaluation sessions, original first60 evaluation closes warmup. Prior5 minimum excludes current close and execution prewindow. Enumerate every ready close including breaks and never-anchored days, not selected account trades.
local_anchor: First strict Close<prior5minimum of each consecutive break run freezes L. Consecutive break days never reset L. First later rolling-qualified close is first_recovery. All subsequent qualified days use this L until next break run. True means Close>=L, apparent means Close<L; equality is true. A fresh break run resets local L even if an older level remains unreclaimed; local true is not full-downtrend recovery.
persistent_anchor_sensitivity: Freeze first break floor until a close actually reclaims it. Intervening lower break runs cannot reset this anchor. After reclaim, keep resolved anchor on qualified days and permit a new anchor at next break. Apply both classifications to the same local first-recovery and all-qualified populations; disclose disagreement, no selection of winning definition.
labels: H10 primary; H1 and H3 duration diagnostics only. Signal T -> one BUY attempt T+1 at original guarded previous raw close+1% limit scaled with signal HFQ/raw ratio. Public TXE fill, better open allowed. If filled at E, earliest SELL E+H, latched through cutoff. Each side .001. Fixed100-share price label only, no capital allocation, no full account or summed compound return. No same-day buy/sell. All BUY failures and pending labels explicit.
censoring: At each actual cutoff, no future fill may complete a label. OPEN retains mark-to-close with buy fee only and is excluded from completed-return means; terminal/no-next BUY and unfilled orders separate, never imputed zero.
summaries: Both anchors x first_recovery/all_qualified x H1,H3,H10 x both cutoffs; counts/fill/censoring; completed net mean/median/Q10, positive and negative contribution, mean without top3/top5, episode-equal mean, signal-year cohorts (not annual NAV acceptance). Report known break age and distance distributions. Raw differences are associations, not causal effects.
dependence: Joint state sampling of fixed20-evaluation-session calendar blocks, 2000 bootstrap replicates seed17, descriptive95% interval; no selection-adjusted inference. State-blind greedy signal spacing H+1 sessions before observing labels, disclose any actual delayed-SELL overlaps; report as scheduled-spaced diagnostic. Additional common-support mean difference within signalyear x breakage bins1/2-5/6plus, weights min(group counts); disclose coverage and no claim full confounding control.
persistence: For each horizon and cutoff: first future loss of rolling support for all qualified signals; loss of frozen local support only if signal Close>=local anchor; first future local reclaim only if signal Close<local anchor. Other cases inapplicable, not censored. Separate horizon and cutoff censoring and event-time distributions, denominators explicit. Future persistence/reclaim times are outcomes only, never classification inputs. Persistent state groups still use these explicitly local-level persistence labels.
counterevidence: Preserve EX023's69 actual C56 below-previous-cycle-break entries,31positive38negative,netcyclelog1.1745165549823025. Their anchor differs from this study; map causal signal dates to new states and keep unmatched cases, never relabel original proof or infer hypothetical filtered account performance.
decision: Only describe supported roles when sign/size are coherent across representative population, both cutoffs, tail removal, overlap diagnostics and anchor sensitivity; these diagnostics are not new economic gates. Reversal, concentration or anchor dependence prevents recommending an automatic reclaim filter. No extra thresholds or account experiments within this authorization.
resources: Single shared pinned input load; vectorized descriptive computation and deterministic bootstrap, native threads1. No independent account evaluations requiring process workers. Independent reviewer audits features/labels/summary before public delivery.
